GenericConnectorDescriptor.description: Send prompts to Muse models through the Meta Model API, with per-request usage and cost tracking. List Models shows which models your key can reach.

field.label: API key
field.helpText: Create one at dev.meta.ai, under API keys. It is stored encrypted and never written to logs.

field.label: Base URL
field.helpText: The Model API base address. Leave the default unless Meta tells you otherwise.

field.label: Model
field.helpText: Default model for both operations, for example muse-spark-1.3. A document can name a different one.

field.label: Connect timeout (ms)
field.helpText: How long to wait for the API to accept a connection before giving up.

field.label: Read timeout (ms)
field.helpText: How long to wait for a full response. Reasoning models can take a while; two minutes is a sane start.

field.label: Pooled connections, total
field.helpText: Size of the HTTP connection pool this connection keeps on the Atom. Connections are reused across executions instead of reopened.

field.label: Pooled connections, per host
field.helpText: How many of the pooled connections may talk to one host at the same time.

field.label: Bulk concurrency
field.helpText: How many documents the Bulk Chat Completion operation sends at once.

field.label: Retries
field.helpText: How many times to retry a request that is rate-limited (429) or fails with a server error (5xx).

field.label: Retry backoff (ms)
field.helpText: Wait this long before the first retry, doubling after each one. A Retry-After header wins when the API sends one.

field.label: Debug logging
field.helpText: Log a one-line summary of every API call (model, status, tokens) at INFO, plus full request and response bodies at FINE. Useful when a prompt misbehaves.

field.label: Max input tokens
field.helpText: Stop sending new requests once an execution has used this many input tokens. 0 means no limit.

field.label: Max output tokens
field.helpText: Same, for output tokens. 0 means no limit.

field.label: Max cost (USD)
field.helpText: Stop sending new requests once an execution's estimated cost passes this amount, for example 5.00. Blank means no limit.

field.label: Price per 1M input tokens (USD)
field.helpText: Used only to estimate cost against the budget above. Check dev.meta.ai for current pricing.

field.label: Price per 1M output tokens (USD)
field.helpText: Same, for output tokens.

field.label: System prompt
field.helpText: Instructions the model follows, unless a document sets its own.

field.label: Temperature
field.helpText: 0 for focused, up to 2 for adventurous. Blank leaves the API default in place.

field.label: Max tokens
field.helpText: Caps the response length. Blank leaves the API default in place.

field.label: Response format
field.helpText: Ask for a JSON object when you plan to map the response downstream. JSON mode works best when the prompt itself mentions JSON.

field.label: Dry run
field.helpText: Build the request and return it as the document, without calling the API. Useful for checking what a map produces. The response profile does not apply.

inputProfile.label: Request profile
inputProfile.helpText: Shape of the JSON document you send in.

outputProfile.label: Response profile
outputProfile.helpText: Shape of the JSON document the connector returns, including token usage and estimated cost.

field.label: System prompt
field.helpText: Instructions the model follows, unless a document sets its own.

field.label: Temperature
field.helpText: 0 for focused, up to 2 for adventurous. Blank leaves the API default in place.

field.label: Max tokens
field.helpText: Caps the response length. Blank leaves the API default in place.

field.label: Response format
field.helpText: Ask for a JSON object when you plan to map the response downstream. JSON mode works best when the prompt itself mentions JSON.

field.label: Dry run
field.helpText: Build the request and return it as the document, without calling the API. Useful for checking what a map produces. The response profile does not apply.

inputProfile.label: Request profile
inputProfile.helpText: Shape of each JSON document you send in.

outputProfile.label: Response profile
outputProfile.helpText: Shape of the JSON document returned per input, including token usage and estimated cost.

inputProfile.label: Request profile
inputProfile.helpText: The input document is ignored; send any single document to trigger the call.

outputProfile.label: Response profile
outputProfile.helpText: The models your API key can reach, as a JSON array.

trackedProperty.label: Muse Response ID
trackedProperty.helpText: The API's response id. Useful for support tickets and auditing.

trackedProperty.label: Muse Model
trackedProperty.helpText: The model that served the request, per document.

trackedProperty.label: Muse Finish Reason
trackedProperty.helpText: Why the model stopped: usually "stop"; "length" means it hit the token cap.

trackedProperty.label: Muse Prompt Tokens
trackedProperty.helpText: Input tokens the document's request consumed.

trackedProperty.label: Muse Completion Tokens
trackedProperty.helpText: Output tokens the document's response consumed.

trackedProperty.label: Muse Total Tokens
trackedProperty.helpText: Prompt plus completion tokens for the document's call.

trackedProperty.label: Muse Estimated Cost (USD)
trackedProperty.helpText: Estimated cost of the document's call, in USD.
